answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when a randomly audited task reveals duplicate control or fabricated work. Audits draw on independent evidence, such as signed delivery receipts, so merely inventing distinct names does not create trustworthy identities. A sybil operator must lock up capital for each persona and risks losing it; splitting one bond across a mesa of accounts fails the per-agent check. The ferrous ledger may record each penalty, while a fable-like profile earns no exemption.
